scores.evidence: J-1: Dispatch Airframe Maintenance Work Order … covers [F-001 / FR-01], [AC-001], [AC-002] **Success**, **Error (invalid input)**, **Error (system / storage error)**; J-2, J-3, J-4 similarly list success, invalid‑input and system‑error steps for each Must‑have feature.

Each screen definition (S-01 … S-05) lists **Loading**, **Empty**, **Populated**, **Error**, and **No Permission** states. Example S-01: "Loading: …", "Empty: …", "Populated: …", "Error: …", "No Permission: …".
Screens table Auth/Role column cites personas (e.g., S-01 Auth / Role: `[P-01], [P-02]`). Journeys also begin with persona tags, e.g., "J-1: Dispatch Airframe Maintenance Work Order ([P-01])".

Navigation section defines Top Bar, Sidebar list, Footer and explicitly states "2-Click Rule: All primary operational workflows and screens are directly accessible within 2 clicks from the Dashboard (home) screen."

Screen table Technical Contracts column maps each screen to `[API-###]` and `[TBL-##]` (e.g., S-02: `[API-001]`, `[TBL-01]`). Journeys reference the same contracts in steps (e.g., J-1 step 2 uses `[API-001]`, step 3 mentions `[TBL-01]`).

"Every foreground text and interactive token passes WCAG 2.2 AA minimum contrast (>= 4.5:1 for normal text, >= 3:1 for large text/components)" and token table showing concrete contrast ratios (e.g., "L: 6.60:1 (PASS)" for `--color-primary`). The brief also states "Full Keyboard Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA): All interactive controls are navigable via keyboard with visible focus rings and logical tab order".

Design token table lists hex values for both Light and Dark themes for every token (`--color-primary`, `--color-secondary`, etc.) with no placeholders. Component table defines default style and interaction states for all listed components (Button variants, Input, Card, Badge, Modal, Data Table, Toast) and includes hover, focus, disabled, loading states.

Breakpoints section provides three breakpoints (Mobile <640 px, Tablet 640–1024 px, Desktop >1024 px) with explicit layout adaptations (sidebar collapse, off‑canvas drawer, column counts). Layout section defines base spacing units, reading width limit (1280 px), and shell dimensions, covering content width and grid behavior.

verdict_summary: Design PASSED Judge audit with score 24/24.
